one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window (Q4 2026 results come in late February 2027). Scheduled: the $0.42 dividend record date 2026-12-11 (immaterial) and the December FOMC decision on 2026-12-16, the last day of the window. Unscheduled but live: an FTC complaint or settlement with Priceline (the FTC may seek more than the $1.0B accrual, src 16), US-Iran war/ceasefire headlines (Manifold's 'war ends before the midterms' resolved NO on 2026-11-03, src 14; Polymarket ceasefire markets thin, src 13), and AI-agent commerce launches (Meta Muse with Expedia knocked BKNG 4-5% in one day in September, src 21). The post-print drift has already played out (stock $157.53 after the Q3 revenue miss on the FTC item); no view on direction, so a symmetric lognormal around spot at the stock's monthly vol 39%/3.5 = 11.1%, with slightly fatter tails for the event risks above.

fair_value.method: Quarterly driver build (room nights x gross bookings per night x take rate, less marketing and sales costs as % of GB and fixed opex) gives NTM GAAP EPS at the horizon of ~$12.94 (FY2027 ~$11.9, FY2028 ~$13.3); x 14.61x P/E (peer median 22.5x shrunk toward BKNG's own 13.1x with k = 0.8) = $189.09.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at 2027-11-16 ~$12.94 (engine, from the quarter build: FY2027 revenue $31,480M, EBIT $11,111M (35.3%), FY2028 revenue $33,852M, EBIT $12,136M; tax 21%; net debt ~$4.9B at the horizon at 8.5%; 706M shares) x 14.61x

inputs_detail.derivation: engine: horizon value 189.09 / 14.61x; built from the drivers in model_inputs; vs consensus FY2027 $12.23 (src 8) our FY2027 is ~3% lower (GAAP incl. intangible amortization and transformation costs vs adjusted)

downside.story: P10: the Iran war and high airfares last into 2027 and horizontal agents (Meta Muse, OpenAI) start to take paid share: room nights ~4% lower than base in every forecast quarter (FY2027 ~+1.7%), take -20 bp, marketing +10 bp of GB, and the P/E de-rates 3 turns to ~11.6x (below EXPE's 15.3x, BKNG's own 13.1x today).

base.story: Median: Q4 2026 at the top of the room-night guide, FY2027 room nights +5.9% on the Tourism Economics 2027 rebound and healthy H1 2027 books, gbrn +2.5%, take -10 bp, modest marketing leverage, fixed costs +5.5% with the $650M transformation savings; FY2027 EPS ~$11.9 (consensus $12.23); 14.6x NTM at the horizon.

upside.story: P90: a durable ceasefire brings the TE +8% 2027 inter-regional rebound, BKNG wins agent distribution (LLM referrals scale with OpenAI/Muse at low cost), room nights +2.5% above base and marketing -5 bp; the P/E re-rates 2.5 turns to ~17x, toward the peer median.

reasoning: Started from the Q3 2026 release and corrected call (src 2, 3): room nights +7%, GB +10%, adjusted revenue +9% but GAAP revenue -1% on a $900M FTC revenue reduction (plus $100M G&A accrual), and a Q4 guide of room nights +1-3%, adjusted revenue 0-2%, EBITDA about flat as the US-Iran war (Manifold src 14) and October disruptions bite. BKNG has beaten its quarterly revenue guide 4 of 4 times by a median 3.3% vs the midpoint, but the first FY2026 guide (low double digits) was cut to high single digits; I set Q4 from a two-year-stack volume build (+3%) and a guided take-rate gap, landing above the revenue range and inside the room-night range. Alternative-lane evidence: Similarweb October visits -8% m/m (seasonal) with affiliate the largest desktop channel (src 11); app trackers noisy (AltIndex inconsistent, src 12; Apptopia MAU +11% y/y in Q4 2025, src 13); LLM referrals <1% of room nights (CFO) while Meta's Muse launched with Expedia and topped the App Store (src 21), the biggest unpriced-by-sell-side risk; newsletters (StrataFinance, FourWeekMBA, Skift/Hospitality.today) frame BKNG growth as share-capture rather than demand, which argues against mapping Tourism Economics' +8% 2027 arrivals one-for-one, so FY2027 room nights +5.9%. Prediction markets on the Iran war are thin or resolved and enter only as context. Valuation: peers are only EXPE and ABNB (Trip.com/MakeMyTrip excluded by rule, UBER off-model); BKNG at 13.1x NTM consensus vs a 22.5x peer median; k = 0.8 gives 14.6x on our ~$12.94 NTM EPS = $189 (+20%). Downside P10 $130 (room nights -4%, take -20 bp, marketing +10 bp, -3 turns) and upside P90 $233 (+2.5% volume, -5 bp marketing, +2.5 turns): a fatter left tail, consistent with 39% realized vol. Research was limited by sec.gov refusing the scripted User-Agent for some pages (read via WebFetch/relays) and X being unreachable; the FY2025 first annual guide was not re-read. Flags: horizon P/E alternatives (own multiple held, -10%) exceed 5%; 2-peer set; Q4 above guide.
